proposal.title: Enable Write-to-Earn Cashtag Attribution and Propagate Experiment Metadata
proposal.reason: Binance Square Write-to-Earn attribution requires explicit cashtags (e.g., $TRUMP, $BTC) for tradeable assets discussed in content. Explicitly instructing the prompt model to include natural cashtags ensures eligible monetization attribution. Additionally, explicitly setting experiment_id, symbol, and content_category inside the draft object ensures downstream publication logs capture experiment metrics correctly instead of tagging them as unknown.
